title: [UE-0.17] Install agent settings
body:
### MVP item (number from docs/jam-brief.md), Day 0, or Stretch: <name>

Day 0

### GDD ref (section + short quote; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### GDD revision (the one in docs/gdd/CURRENT, e.g. 1.3)

1.3

### Features (IDs from docs/feature-manifest.json; add "Hook only" for an interface + default flag with no behavior, OPEN/PROPOSED only; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Player outcome (the player sees X, does Y, can tell why; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Owner role

Agent Ops

### Reviewer role (must differ from owner)

Technical Director

### Human who runs and merges this

Josh

### Inputs and outputs (exact paths)

Inputs: the files the Done-when names. Outputs: `.claude/**`, `.gitignore`

### Context (what the code or asset next to Outputs does today, with file:line)

new files only

### File lane, do-not-touch paths, binary files to lock

Lane: `.claude/**`, `.gitignore`
Do not touch: Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/**
Locks: none

### Out of scope (behaviors not to build; the reviewer rejects them)

anything outside the lane

### After (cards that must merge first: #<n> or UE-<n>, comma separated; "none")

UE-0.0

### Used by (BPs, maps, widgets or components that read what this card changes; follow-up card IDs)

UE-0.9

### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

build, tests, Windows packaging machine

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] The agent makes the `.gitignore` lines and the `.claude/` files `python3 tools/secrets_check.py --install` writes, as the card's gate patch
- [ ] Kickoff applies it itself through the tool checks (`python3 tools/git_gate.py apply UE-0.17 --auto`: every path in the card's lane, no guardrail enforcer changed, no guardrail file loosened; the PR has a `GATE EDIT: by=kickoff` line naming the patched paths); `python3 tools/secrets_check.py --rules secret,secretfile,gitignore,settings,agents` exits 0 on the branch (pasted). Rules `mcp` and `components` are card 0.4a's
- [ ] After the merge kickoff sets branch protection on `main` itself (required status check `checks`, the job name in `pipeline-checks.yml`, the `card` job runs on issues only; no force push, no delete; no required review: the card's reviewer agent approves and kickoff merges) and lets GitHub Actions create pull requests (`main-red.yml` opens revert PRs), and posts the `gh api` read-back on the card (`tools/kickoff.py` repo_settings)
- [ ] `python3 tools/install_git_hooks.py --check` exits 0 on every clone: kickoff installs the hooks on each machine it runs on, and each card 0.9 session pastes the check on the card 0.9 smoke issue
- [ ] Each card 0.9 session pastes `python3 tools/secrets_check.py --rules settings,agents` from its machine on the card 0.9 smoke issue (`pipeline/agent-ops/README.md`)
- [ ] Done by the Clock's card 0.9 cutoff

### Budget and cut tier

60 min agent + 15 min human, MVP

### Unknowns (Decision needed / Why it matters / Proposed test / Choice; "none" if none)

none
